items.title: Find the marked doer

sentence.sm: Sā fafaga e le tama le moa.

parts.note: The agent marker *e* marks the boy as the one who fed the hen.
The hen is the one the action happened to. It stands bare.

items.caption: Tap each part. The agent marker marks the doer; the one the action happened to is unmarked.

items.title: Who does the action?

data.question: Who is named as the doer?

prompts.sm: Sā fafaga e le tama le moa.
prompts.why: The phrase *e le tama* marks the boy as the doer.

prompts.sm: Sā tatala e le teine le pusa.
prompts.why: The phrase *e le teine* marks the girl as the doer.

prompts.sm: E tausi pepe e le fafine.
prompts.why: The first *e* is the general particle; the second marks *le fafine* as the doer.

items.intro: Look for the marker after the verb, then choose the person it marks.

items.title: The doer can disappear

states.label: With the doer
states.sm: Sā tatala e le teine le pusa.
states.note: The girl is named with the agent marker.

states.label: Without the doer
states.note: The doer is gone. The verb keeps its shape and the box stays bare.

items.caption: Switch between the printed sentences. Removing the doer adds no replacement word and makes no change to the verb.
